text: L7 `m33l7wch` gives the `plugins:base` mount the directory 'katalogi pakietów-pluginów w katalogu `node_modules` workspace'u', and M13 `m26esec` says adding, removing or updating a base package works without a restart. The base mount is discovered from the packages the start resolved (the directory of each resolved ESM entry), so an update or a removal of an installed package reloads live, but a listed package that was missing at start and is installed later — or a package added to the list (`workspace.json` is read once per process, M31 view) — is neither mounted nor loaded until the next start. The pages do not say whether 'adding a package' means installing a package already on the list (which would need the whole workspace `node_modules` observed, plus a load path for a package that never loaded) or only replacing an installed one. Assumed: only the packages resolved at start are watched; a package installed or listed later takes effect from the next start (behaviour unchanged by this window, now counted from the workspace `node_modules`).
assumption: ASSUMPTION:dev-0302 — only the packages resolved at start are watched; one installed (or listed) later takes effect from the next start.
